field.label: Classify connections
field.help: Name each connection's application with nDPI and keep the servers it names in pf tables, aliases in Firewall: Aliases. It reads a copy of what the firewall sees and changes no traffic. Off, the classifier stops and its aliases leave Firewall: Aliases - switched off instead where a rule or a setting still names one.

field.label: Interfaces
field.help: Where connections are read. None chosen: every internal interface - one with an address of its own and no gateway. No port is made promiscuous.

field.label: Application tables
field.help: A table of its own for each application chosen, appcontrol_ and its name, holding servers it was seen with. Every nDPI category has a table without being chosen: appcontrol_cat_ and its name. The list is the installed nDPI's.

field.label: Address expiry (seconds)
field.help: How long an address stays in a table once unseen: the Expire of the tables' aliases, carried out by OPNsense's own cron. Seen again, its time starts again.
